name: Never Have I Ever
description: After a traumatic year, all an Indian-American teen wants is to go from pariah to popular -- but friends, family and feeling won't make it easy on her.

videos.title: Pilot
videos.overview: After recent trauma, Devi starts her first day as a high school sophomore determined to shake off old labels and finally become cool.

videos.title: ... had sex with Paxton Hall-Yoshida
videos.overview: Devi hesitates to tell her friends the truth about her awkward interactions with Paxton. The prospect of an arranged marriage puts Kamala under pressure.

videos.title: ... gotten drunk with the popular kids
videos.overview: Devi hopes to win cool points with Paxton at a party, until a surprising turn of events. Hidden emotions emerge for Fabiola. Kamala makes a choice.

videos.title: ... felt super Indian
videos.overview: At Ganesh Puja celebrations, Devi questions how much she identifies with Indian culture, Nalini dodges acerbic aunties and Kamala frets over her future.

videos.title: ... started a nuclear war
videos.overview: Devi allows rumors about her and Paxton to swirl during an overnight school trip. Fabiola opens up to Eleanor, who gets upsetting news about her mother.

videos.title: ... been the loneliest boy in the world
videos.overview: With absentee parents, a shallow girlfriend and no one to hang out with, Ben Gross is lonelier than ever, until an unlikely invitation offers some hope.

videos.title: ... been a big, fat liar
videos.overview: Devi oversteps several boundaries in an attempt to be a better friend. Eleanor’s reunion with her mother leads to multiple revelations and confessions.

videos.title: ... pissed off everyone I know
videos.overview: After another fallout with her friends, Devi grapples with unresolved trauma. A party at Ben’s turns out to be equal parts awkward, awful and amazing.

videos.title: ... had to be on my best behavior
videos.overview: Flashbacks unearth painful memories and resentment for Devi. Meanwhile, Kamala is forced to get honest as the family welcomes her suitor at home.

videos.title: ... said I'm sorry
videos.overview: After unwelcome news sparks a fight with her mother, Devi seeks an escape. Mohan’s birthday brings an opportunity for closure — and for new beginnings.

videos.title: … been a playa
videos.overview: Ahead of their impending move to India, Devi faces her first-ever love triangle, while Nalini tries to sell her patient roster to a flashy competitor.

videos.title: ... thrown a rager
videos.overview: Devi plans to throw the ultimate party, but her knotty dating life may turn it into a different kind of blowout. Nalini has an eye-opening trip to India.

videos.title: ... opened a textbook
videos.overview: Making good grades has never been a priority for Paxton — until a mishap urges him to prove he’s more than a campus heartthrob and star swimmer.

videos.title: ... had an Indian frenemy
videos.overview: Devi instantly resents the new Indian girl at school, but is taken by surprise as they get acquainted. Kamala struggles to be respected at her lab.

videos.title: ... ruined someone's life
videos.overview: At a 24-hour school relay, Devi’s impulsive words spark an insensitive rumor. Fabiola hesitates to introduce her overenthusiastic mother to Eve.

videos.title: ... betrayed a friend
videos.overview: While attempting to cover her trail for fueling gossip about Aneesa, Devi's guilt grows. Nalini warms up to a nemesis. Kamala gets a rude shock.

videos.title: ... begged for forgiveness
videos.overview: Devi must learn the art of a genuine apology before it’s too late. Kamala considers standing up for herself. Nalini takes some parenting advice.

videos.title: ... been Daisy Buchanan
videos.overview: Watching an ex with someone new tests Devi’s resolve to be more mature. Fabiola struggles to stay true to herself, and grows concerned for Eleanor.

videos.title: ... stalked my own mother
videos.overview: A disastrous snooping incident compels Devi and Nalini to do some introspection. Paxton steps out of his comfort zone. Eleanor has a breakthrough.

videos.title: ... been a perfect girl
videos.overview: As Paxton's mixed messages have Devi questioning herself, the upcoming winter dance offers a chance to determine where she stands — and what she needs.

videos.title: ...been slut-shamed
videos.overview: At last, Devi is dating her dream guy, but some catty gossip has her worried about taking things slow. Nalini urges Kamala to rethink a decision.

videos.title: ...had my own troll
videos.overview: Anonymous messages about Paxton have Devi playing detective. Aneesa feels neglected by Ben. Pati hosts a mixer to find Kamala a "suitable" partner.

videos.title: …had a valentine
videos.overview: On Valentine's Day, a compatibility test's results spark more drama than romance among the Sherman Oaks couples. Meanwhile, Nalini makes a new friend.

videos.title: ...made someone jealous
videos.overview: Kamala invites Manish over for Navratri, to Pati's annoyance. Devi isn't thrilled about taking Rhyah's son to a house party, but she's in for a surprise.

videos.title: ...been ghosted
videos.overview: A charity event gives Devi the chance to polish her rusty flirting skills. As awkward vibes between Fabiola and Aneesa lingers, Paxton offers advice.

videos.title: ...had a breakdown
videos.overview: Chasing Ivy League dreams and his dad's approval, Ben ignores warning signs of burnout until the stress of his jam-packed workload builds up — literally.

videos.title: ...cheated
videos.overview: Up against Des' team at a debate tournament, Devi takes her competitiveness too far. An opportunity arises for Eleanor. Pati explains herself to Kamala.

videos.title: ...hooked up with my boyfriend
videos.overview: A game night gives Devi and Fab a chance for alone time with Des and Aneesa, but other guests throw the evening off course. An art tutor surprises Ben.

videos.title: …had an Indian boyfriend
videos.overview: Watching Devi struggle with a painful memory, a nervous Rhyah orders Des to keep his distance. Paxton enlists Eleanor's help to break some news to Trent.

videos.title: ...lived the dream
videos.overview: The end of the school year has the Sherman Oaks crew all up in their feels. Devi is torn between planning the future and enjoying the present.

videos.title: ...lost my virginity
videos.overview: An awkward end to an intimate moment has Devi fuming all summer. As senior year begins, the crew has college — and complicated feelings — on the brain.

videos.title: ...gotten sweet revenge
videos.overview: Bent on exposing who vandalized her car, Devi makes a bold accusation. Fabiola shakes up the robotics club's culture. Pati hides a secret from the family.

videos.title: ...liked a bad boy
videos.overview: As senior year continues to spiral, Devi's resolve to avoid Ethan weakens. Paxton returns to a comforting place. Nalini tackles termite issues.

videos.title: ...wrecked my future
videos.overview: At a college fair, Devi juggles her love life with her academic ambitions, Fabiola ponders a tricky decision and an unlikely ally comes to Ben's rescue.

videos.title: ...been to New Jersey
videos.overview: On a school trip to New York, Devi discovers that college may be scarier than she thought, Eleanor faces disappointment and Fabiola remains tight-lipped.

videos.title: ...had my dream stolen
videos.overview: With early college admissions rolling in, Devi's in for more than one surprise. Kamala warns a smitten Pati about Len. Ben overhears a hurtful comment.

videos.title: ...had an identity crisis
videos.overview: As Paxton struggles to let go of his past as the king of high school, he seizes a chance to thrive as a swim coach and finds closure with an old flame.

videos.title: ...set my mom up
videos.overview: Unsure about her own love life, Devi focuses on Nalini's — but it will mean befriending an enemy. Pati's birthday ends on a high note no one sees coming.

videos.title: ...gone to prom
videos.overview: After a major setback, Devi feels the burden of telling a lie and must dig deep for a second chance. On prom night, the friends share their truths.

videos.title: ...said goodbye
videos.overview: The last weekend of summer coincides with a festive occasion — and on the brink of their new lives, Devi, her family and friends have lots to celebrate.
